notes.title: Update 5.2.2025
notes.notes:
Updated default branch with beta branch fixes

Current development status

Westard is going through upgrade/remake progress from Unity 5 to Unity 6. In the progress game has been remade with new physics interactions, new networking system and whole lot of new assets.

This is still ongoing process, but you can follow the updates on our discord

notes.title: Holiday update! Teleport locomotion & wew missions
notes.notes:
Updating current beta branch to default(master) branch. Update brings a lot of new content and features for those who hasn't yet tried beta. These updates include relay servers (yay!), new missions, new weapons and AI improvements as well as whole new AI system on the new missions. Older missions still use old AI systems and are expected to get new AI update on beta branch early next year. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27671761/c84e0aa6c89aca8c99726e13c32078398e0e1b71.png


Teleport locomotion (alpha)
Updated network system with relay servers. No more port forwarding!
New AI on new missions, Old AI improvements on old missions
Two new missions:

Jail
Money delivery

New weapons
Healing with bandages
Fixed some usability issues with oculus devices
Improved touchpad movement and playspace rotation on touch controllers
Ability to switch weapons directly from holsters
General improvements and bug fixes


Happy holidays!

notes.title: New update on public beta
notes.notes:
New update on public beta. Opt in to the "beta" branch on steam settings, if you want to try it out. New mission will be available to test on beta branch soonish before going live


Relay servers for more reliable connections
New holster system Holsters no longer block weapons on ground when trying to pick them up, weapons can be switched directly from holsters
Added new weapons: Colt Walker, Gatling gun and some new melee weapons
Added healing with bandages
Added some hand poses synced over network
Added arms swinger locomotion option (teleporting is coming too, but it's still work in progress)
Avatar animation tweaks
Improved physics materials on objects
Updated SteamVR SDK
Fixed crash when disconnecting from co-op game and joining pvp game
Fixed crash when joining game gameview minimized
Fixed issue on oculus devices that caused frame drops and weird delays when removing headset while playing
Fixed AI aiming into sky
Fixed AI running in circles
Fixed avatars doing splits when walking (maybe)
Fixed double barrel shotguns not working on clients
Fixed double barrel shotguns being visible when holstered
General fixed and improvements

notes.title: Patch notes v.0.5911
notes.notes:
Patch notes v.0.5911


Added lobby browser:

New lobbies are created with friends only privacy so if you wan't your lobby to be shown to the public you need to toggle privacy setting to public
You can join game during pvp matches, but not during missions. Co-Op mission lobbies are locked when starting mission
Game is missing notification when players join game, so don't scare people!

Fixed Colt SA not correctly removing fired bullets
Minor AI Fix: Patrolling enemy ignored player while moving

notes.title: Patch notes v.0.591
notes.notes:
Patch notes v.0.591

Added option for playspace rotation for 180° setups: 45°, 90° snap and smooth rotation
Added running: Double click active touchpad controller to start running
Added marker for dynamites on Canyon mission
Added mission and gamemode names when selecting mission


Fixed issue when picking up weapon from ground and grabbing other weapon from holster at the same time resulting two weapons in hand
Fixed dynamites not being holsterable
Fixed issue when player died squeezing both controllers and not being able to respawn
Fixed issue where Colt SA drum was constantly spinning
Improved bullet inserting in Colt SA so controllers won't collide to each other so easily
Some minor performance improvements


Changed how ingame menu is opened: point left controller towards your face touchpad facing away from your face. Or if it helps: when holding weapon just point the gun at your face!
Improved Colt SA cocking with other hand to experience better 'Fan the hammer' feeling


Oh and you don't need dynamite to open safe, you can just pick lock it by hand! But if you have a dynamite, it's always faster!
